objective: Official-source acceptance checklist for root's native Merchant Center menu completion

evidence: before and after values when corrected

menu_items.settings: Confirm Merchant 513542500, domain, date range, account standing and setup cards.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Dated overview reconciled to Products and Data sources; every blocking card has a resolved result or named pending dependency.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Dismissed cards and predicted growth benefits are not completion evidence.

menu_items.settings: Triage policy, product-data and processing alerts; preserve useful operational alerts.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Each issue has affected source/countries/products, corrective evidence and current status.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Optional recommendations and marketing messages may remain declined; do not enable a paid feature to clear a card.

menu_items.settings: Reconcile the dated 240-parent/4,945-variant inventory to received identities. Check apparel age, gender, color, size, grouping, identifiers, selected-piece images, price/currency and availability.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Offer-level free-listing country status plus matching translated landing/checkout and accurate schema. Review price, availability and condition automations against actual pages.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: No fabricated GTIN/MPN or blanket in-stock claims. Disable price automation when ambiguous strike-through prices prevent accurate extraction; automations cannot replace feed updates or certify immediate stock.

menu_items.settings: Match serviced countries, rate currency, thresholds, handling/transit, cutoffs and exceptions to actual checkout. Shopify automatic imports cover General-profile rates; identify overwrite ownership. Set returns URL, countries, windows, methods, fees and product-exception labels.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Checkout comparisons and Google's verified return-policy status; accurate swimwear/intimates/Final Sale exclusions wherever applicable.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: No invented transit/refund duration, free returns or physical pickup. Automatic shipping updates require trustworthy crawl/tracking data and currently affect only U.S. destinations.

menu_items.settings: Review shipping, returns, browsing and purchase signals by available country; prioritize truthful gaps, mobile speed and useful imagery.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Current category metrics, data sufficiency and badge status; allow measurement lag.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Missing scores can reflect insufficient impressions. A badge is earned, not a setting. Never broaden returns, invent reviews or claim a badge to improve the score.

menu_items.settings: Use genuine DLM branding and inspect the actual upload slot. Brand-profile logos require 1:1, 500–2,000px, BMP/JPEG/PNG, ≤5MB; that surface requires super-admin access.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Readable preview and actual review status, distinguishing pending from approved. Confirm any different native slot's own requirements.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Product Studio is optional. Publish creative only after product/quantity/color/copy accuracy checks; do not manufacture visuals or achievements merely to fill this menu.

menu_items.settings: Read linked Ads IDs, campaign status, destinations, budgets and countries; assess existing campaign consumption of expanded products.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Recorded current settings and no paid changes in this audit.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: No campaign is required for free listings. Leave creation/enablement/bids/budgets untouched; an unused campaign menu is valid.

menu_items.settings: Submit only an existing, genuinely redeemable eligible offer with correct products, countries, dates/time zone, codes, minimums and exclusions.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Checkout redemption evidence and both policy/product approval; pending review stays pending.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Leave empty when no qualifying live offer exists. Routine free shipping or an already-discounted product price is not automatically an additional promotion.

menu_items.settings: Verify free-listing account permission, source/item destinations and country status. Reuse the existing 65-country/21-language matrix.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Received offer eligibility by supported country/language; all 21 languages are theoretically supported, while 36 countries/63 pairs describe Shopify-app coverage only.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Unknown countries remain unresolved; opt-in does not guarantee display. Local-inventory/pickup methods are inapplicable to DLM.

menu_items.settings: Use Organic traffic with consistent dates, country/product breakdowns, impressions, clicks and CTR; reconcile purchase/value tracking with the existing measurement owner.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Saved report and verified event-source identity, attribution and deduplication; test tagged landing URLs.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Auto-tagging alone does not configure purchases. No-data remains no-data; traffic is not profit. Custom dashboards are optional.

menu_items.settings: Review interface language/time zone, existing CSS/free-listing selection, auto-tagging and key-event source. Keep account architecture appropriate to one merchant.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Intentional settings, functioning tagged URLs and correct CSS where applicable.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Advanced-account conversion, data-sharing and marketing-content use need a concrete purpose. Product protection excludes API/automated sources: it cannot safeguard Shopify's API feed. For eligible file feeds, choose a justified threshold and genuine-removal procedure.

menu_items.settings: Verify correct business identity, claimed storefront domain, genuine business address, support URL/contact channels and actual service availability.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Verified/claimed domain and working public support/policy links matching the business.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Do not represent a mailing address as a retail location, warehouse or owned inventory. Physical-store/POS setup and unsupported identity attributes remain inapplicable.

menu_items.settings: Read exact Shopify source ownership, source type, languages/feed labels, countries, latest processing, offer counts, issues and quota. Reuse identities and inspect attribute rules.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Fresh receipt in Merchant 513542500 reconciled to Shopify; no duplicate ownership and documented uncovered language offers.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Shopify feedback without Merchant ID is insufficient. Do not reinstall, relink or duplicate uploads to clear onboarding. Supplements enrich existing offers; they cannot create missing language offers. Automatic discovery is not complete-catalog proof.

menu_items.settings: Inventory available/active add-ons and their actual dependencies. Use advanced source management or custom reports only for a defined need.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Each add-on has an enabled-with-evidence, intentionally-off, or unavailable outcome.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Leave local inventory, vehicles and unnecessary regional features off. Automated discounts need verified economics; remarketing is outside this free-listing lane. Reviews/loyalty/checkout integrations need real programs and working integration, not fabricated data.

menu_items.settings: Confirm owner recovery/admin access, appropriate roles, pending requests and exact existing Shopify/Google service links.
menu_items.accepted_evidence: Authorized service IDs and role inventory, without persisting personal contacts; Business Manager and linked-app permissions checked separately.
menu_items.optional_off_conditions: Do not invite users, approve unknown requests or connect extra apps for completeness. A physical Business Profile is inapplicable; preserve the separate tracking owner's configuration.

material_applicability_notes.conclusion: Not available for API or automated sources; do not count the toggle as protection for Shopify API ingestion.
Current effects limited to United States destinations; crawl or historical tracking data needed.

Product Studio's link labeled business logos currently resolves to the brand-profile logo guide. Apply specifications only to the exact observed slot; do not extrapolate legacy rectangular-logo requirements.
Google treats in_stock, preorder and backorder as compatible in some matching. Read actual availability and fulfillment evidence; automation is not stock certification.
